title: Sankey ribbons by view configuration
description: One row per view mode, named-field count, grouped citing and cited field pair, and pre-grouping same/cross/unclassified flow class. Field rank is by endpoint totals. Smaller fields are rolled up without dropping links.
code:
f=load('T2').copy(); f['flow']=np.where((f.source_id=='unknown')|(f.target_id=='unknown'),'unknown',np.where(f.source_id==f.target_id,'same','cross')); parts=[]
for mode,k in [('All citations',None),('Cross-field only','cross'),('Same-field only','same')]:
    rows=f if k is None else f[f.flow==k]
    score=rows.groupby('source_id').n.sum().add(rows.groupby('target_id').n.sum(),fill_value=0).drop('unknown',errors='ignore')
    order=sorted(score.index,key=lambda x:(-score[x],x))
    for fields in range(4,15):
        chosen=order[:fields]; rank={id:i for i,id in enumerate(chosen+['other','unknown'])}; r=rows.copy()
        for side in ['source','target']:
            ok=r[side+'_id'].isin([*chosen,'unknown']); r.loc[~ok,side+'_id']='other'; r.loc[~ok,side]='Other fields'
        v=r.groupby(['source_id','source','target_id','target','flow'],as_index=False).n.sum(); v['source_rank']=v.source_id.map(rank); v['target_rank']=v.target_id.map(rank); v['mode']=mode; v['fields']=fields
        assert v.n.sum()==rows.n.sum()
        parts.append(v)
out=pd.concat(parts,ignore_index=True); print(out.shape); save_table(out,'Sankey ribbons by view configuration','One row per view mode, named-field count, grouped citing and cited field pair, and pre-grouping same/cross/unclassified flow class. Field rank is by endpoint totals. Smaller fields are rolled up without dropping links.')
